question: Find the surface area (rounded off to the nearest integer) of a sphere of radius 6.5 cm. (Take π = 22/7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface area of a sphere = 4 × π × r²

Using fractional values for faster calculation: r = 6.5 cm = 13/2 cm

Surface Area = 4 × (22/7) × (13/2) × (13/2)

Surface Area = (22 × 169) ÷ 7 = 3718 ÷ 7

Surface Area = 531.14 cm² ≈ 531 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 531 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the sphere (r) = 6.5 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of a sphere = 4πr²

 
 
 
 
• 
 r = 6.5 cm
 Surface Area = 4πr²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × (22/7) × (6.5)²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × (22/7) × 42.25

⇒ Surface Area = (88 × 42.25) ÷ 7

⇒ Surface Area = 3718 ÷ 7

⇒ Surface Area = 531.1428... cm²

⇒ Rounding off to the nearest integer, we get 531 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 531 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The volume of a sphere can be calculated using the formula V = (4/3)πr³, where r is the radius.

Hemisphere Properties

A hemisphere has a curved surface area (CSA) of 2πr² and a total surface area (TSA) of 3πr².

Diameter Relation

The diameter (d) is twice the radius (d = 2r). The surface area can also be expressed as πd².
